title: First Choice Bank sets Oct. 15 closure hours in Pontotoc and Ecru
excerpt: First Choice Bank’s two Pontotoc offices and Ecru branch will close from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Thursday. Three other branches and ATMs will remain available.

paragraphs.text: First Choice Bank will temporarily close its Main Office, Pontotoc Branch and Ecru Branch from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, according to a bank notice shared Wednesday by the Town of Ecru.
The affected offices are the Main Office at 19 South Main Street in Pontotoc, the Pontotoc Branch at 236 Highway 15 North and the Ecru Branch at 7670 Highway 15 North in Ecru.
The bank’s Tupelo, Southaven and Houlka branches will remain open during the closure. Its ATMs will remain available around the clock, according to the notice.
First Choice Bank’s website lists regular Thursday branch hours as 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The public telephone number listed for each affected office is 662-489-1631.
